title: scanVerificationCache
responsibility: Classifies verification-cache entries as registered, valid records or protected inventory rows by checking directory safety, record schema, path identity, and declared evidence files.

inputs.name: scanVerificationCache.root
inputs.description: The repository root used to build the .cache ancestor paths and to make inventory paths repository-relative. The function does not verify that it is a Git root or that store is inside it.

inputs.name: scanVerificationCache.store
inputs.description: The directory whose immediate child names are scanned as commit entries. A missing directory returns the current context, while an unreadable listing is recorded in problems and a non-directory or symlink is protected and stops the scan.

outputs.name: scanVerificationCache
outputs.description: Resolves to a CacheScanContext containing the input paths, protected inventory entries, valid run entries, and scan problems. A run is added to valid only when its tree has no protection reasons, its record validates, its lowercase 40-character commit directory matches the record source commit, its directory name matches the record start time, and its files are declared.
